parents.subject: Technology Entrepreneurship
parents.course: Startups: Incorporation, Funding, Contracts, & Intellectual Property

ns2:section.sectionText: Explore how legal tools may be used in the construction and successful operation of your company to deliver the next great product to market. Topics include: issues with business formation, intellectual property, non-disclosure agreements, contracts, and other corporate legal issues impacting startups. This course will be delivered via Compass 2g. Optional online discussion on Fridays from 11 am - 11:50 am
